startersHint: A starter picks the language, how many words show at once and the look of the captions. You can change all of it.
languageHint: Choose the language you speak, or the browser may write the wrong words.
wordsPer: Words on screen at a time
wordsHint: Fewer words make quick, punchy captions. More words make full lines.
privacyTitle: Before you speak: where your voice goes
privacy: Turning speech into text is done by your browser's own service, not by this site. In Chrome and Edge your voice is sent to Google or Microsoft to be turned into words, and Safari uses Apple. Nothing is sent to {siteName}, and the video is made on your device. If you do not want your voice sent anywhere, use Tap-to-Time Captions instead, where you type the words and tap the timing.
unsupported: This browser cannot turn speech into text. Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari. You can still try the sample below, or use Tap-to-Time Captions, where you type the words yourself.
listening: Listening: {seconds} s. Speak clearly, in short sentences.
listeningHint: The words appear below as you speak. Tap Stop when you are done.
sampleHint: Fills the box with four example sentences, with no microphone and no voice sent anywhere.
blocked: The microphone or speech service was blocked. Allow the microphone for this page, then try again.
network: The speech service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
other: Speech recognition could not start in this browser.
noRecording: The sound could not be recorded at the same time, so only the captions are saved. You can add your own audio in your editing app.
nothing: Nothing was heard. Speak a little louder and closer to the microphone, then try again.
checkHint: Fix any word the browser got wrong. Each row is one phrase you spoke. Remove a row you do not want. The captions are made from these rows.
nudgeHint: The browser reports words a moment after they are said. If captions look late, move them earlier.
scripts: Hindi, Tamil and other scripts are drawn with your device's own font, so the video looks like your phone shows them.
notSaved: Your recording and words are not saved between visits, only your settings. Save your files before you leave the page.
